items.title: ESM’s Retail Wrap – Alimerka, Carrefour Spain, Lantmännen Unibake, Lidl Spain
items.summary: Alimerka teams up with Uber Eats; Carrefour Spain overhauls pet range; Lantmännen Unibake finalises acquisition; Lidl invests in Spain.

items.title: Kraft Heinz expects return to growth in 2027 as innovation investments pay off
items.summary: Recent launches, including ketchup with lower sugar and gluten-free cream cheese, are helping grow market share and volume.

items.title: Tesco Invites Suppliers To Join Climate Data-Sharing Programme
items.summary: Tesco has invited around 400 of its key suppliers across the UK and Ireland to join a data sharing platform to support decarbonisation.

items.title: Kraft Heinz details $700 million turnaround plan
items.summary: Kraft Heinz outlined its $700 million investment in marketing, pricing, talent and products, targeting a return to growth in the second half of 2027.

items.title: Once Upon a Farm maintains 2027 growth plans amid Tractor Wheels recall
items.summary: Once Upon a Farm entered the fourth quarter on pace to exceed its financial targets, but a voluntary recall of its Tractor Wheels snack line prompted the company to lower its 2026 outlook and absorb up to $30 million in recall-related costs.

items.title: European Retail Groups Call For Proportionate Digital Fairness Rules
items.summary: Three retail groups raise concerns over the EU’s proposed Digital Fairness Act and changes to consumer protection cooperation rules.

items.title: What does the new unfair trading practices regulation mean for food?
items.summary: In food and agriculture, smaller players, particularly farmers, often have far less bargaining power than larger companies. A directive on unfair trading practices in the EU aimed to change that. The Unfair Trading Practices Regulation sets out to improve enforcement of this…

items.title: Sales At UK Supermarket Asda Stall As New Boss Takes Reins
items.summary: Asda reported flat Q3 like-for-like sales on Friday, highlighting the scale of the revival challenge facing new chief executive David Potts.

items.title: Striped Socks Keep FamilyMart A Step Ahead In Japan's Convenience Store Wars
items.summary: Japan's second-largest convenience store chain FamilyMart is building on that fashion credential with a wider range of lifestyle items.

items.title: Leftovers: Hershey bakes Reese’s pie for Thanksgiving | Tostitos adds zesty twist to Scoops
items.summary: The sweets giant is introducing a 3-pound peanut butter cup for holiday hosting, while Cutwater gets festive with a Gingerbread White Russian.

items.title: Albert Heijn Launches Christmas Range Amid Rising Consumer Interest
items.summary: Albert Heijn has rolled out a festive range ahead of Christmas, supported by a special edition magazine and holiday-themed recipes in its app.

items.title: Packaging progress: 5 food and beverage companies making sustainability swaps
items.summary: From paper wrappers to recycled plastic containers, six food and beverage companies are making packaging changes to reduce waste and improve recyclability.

items.title: How wide is the GLP-1 halo?
items.summary: The GLP-1 halo effect, where consumers follow diets similar to those of GLP-1 users without taking the drugs, is highly influential on consumer demand. In fact, suggests Kline and Company, the halo is far larger than the drugs' actual user base.
